gate: Forge Gate B 4B - Offline Alpha Extraction Spike
review_basis: Judge the frozen raw.png beside the actual v2 96x96 transparent result. Never infer a part from the prompt alone.

frozen_raw_identity_baseline.source: User-approved Gate B 4B contract; this does not alter the pending Gate B 4A review file.

part_review_rule: For each part, record whether it is visible in raw and, when visible in raw, whether v2 preserves the same visible structure. A missing raw part is not an alpha-extraction success or failure.
text_rule: Clock-face numerals and hands are intrinsic identity markings, not extraneous text or a watermark.

B01.gate_specific_rule: Both seeds must preserve the visible hose and nozzle or suction head.

B02.gate_specific_rule: Twin bells are explicitly expected on seed 4041001; clock-face numerals are intrinsic markings.

B03.gate_specific_rule: Seed 4041001 must remain a successful usable alpha delivery.

B04.gate_specific_rule: Both seeds must preserve the visible thin stem and base.

reviewer_policy: The final human_structure_review.csv must record an explicit human reviewer. Automated image or prompt inspection cannot be labelled human review.
